summary: A successful worktree delivery left the canonical user checkout stale, making a real GitHub delivery look missing.
expected: Release evidence identifies both working paths and reconciles the user-facing checkout or clearly reports the remaining divergence.
actual: Coopain main was already pushed/merged with exact-SHA green CI, while the original folder still showed aa382779 and uncommitted J01-J05. Reversible checkpoint comparison and synchronization resolved it; 24 unique local files and ignored data were preserved.
reproduction: Compare original coopain main and delivery worktree history against GitHub main f3a8c13e; see the retained sanitized reconciliation receipt.
impact: User could not see the delivered product in the folder they were using, despite a correct GitHub delivery.
suggestion: Implemented a precise delivery-provenance requirement in the 2026-10-08.1 public guide and all three follow-up handoffs. Keep Git mutation manual/authorized and preserve local data.
